objective: Introduce single-host SQLite WAL/FULL transactional immutable operation intents, serialized generation reservation, pre-send UNKNOWN marking and deliberately blocked uncertain recovery. No remote fencing or exact-once claim.
nonGoals: No distributed SQLite coordination, shared WAL over NFS, remote target effects, power-loss proof or unattended retry after unknown outcome
No automatic acknowledgement of an external effect based on an unauthenticated receipt
No changes to existing SF-15 simulated-memory fixture outputs
decisions: Use sqlite3 stdlib BEGIN IMMEDIATE, WAL, synchronous FULL; reject unresolved reservation instead of expiry-based retry.
A generation is an internal allocation only. External fencing and authenticated receipt are PQ-05 responsibilities; evidence may remain UNKNOWN indefinitely.

obligations.description: Commit identity and immutable content digest before allowing dispatch reservation; reject same key with changed intent.
Serialize contenders via SQLite write transaction; maintain monotonic generation; reject stale token/unknown state.
Commit possible-send uncertainty before calling target; process restart cannot blindly retry unknown effect.

structure: src/sf/durable_ledger.py: durable bounded transactional state and monotonic generations
tests/test_durable_ledger.py: restart, competing reservations, ambiguous dispatch, immutable key, stale generation
docs/factory/evidence/PQ-04.md: process/disk/power and remote fence limits
impact: New opt-in local persistence library; no external connector wired or installed

budget.execution: Targeted local DB tests and one required hosted run on stable PR

externalEffects: Only SQLite temporary test files in CI; no production data store or live destination effects
